note: Phase 6 used disposable keys and tiny caps. The factory has no admin, so this address is the production factory. These two roots are disposable staging roots, not a shared treasury. A later relay through the hosted backend moved 1 raw unit from root A, so its balance after that receipt is 139997.

transactions.name: deploy_factory
transactions.expected: RootFactory bytecode is deployed and implementation() is code

transactions.name: fund_registrar_b
transactions.expected: registrar B receives 0.3 USDC so it can pay gas for createRoot

transactions.name: create_root_a
transactions.expected: registrar A owns root A as an index only

transactions.name: create_root_b
transactions.expected: registrar B is a different wallet and root B is a different contract

transactions.name: open_tab_a
transactions.expected: PQ execute opens a Barkeep tab owned by root A, funded with the exact cap, exposure increases by the cap
transactions.actual: tab owner is root A, tab balance 100000, root balance 150000 to 50000, openExposure 100000

transactions.name: open_tab_b
transactions.expected: root B opens its own tab for agent B
transactions.actual: tab balance 100000, root balance 150000 to 50000, openExposure 100000

transactions.name: agent_a_spend
transactions.expected: allowlisted payee receives 10000 from tab A; tab isValidSignature returns 0x1626ba7e

transactions.name: agent_b_spend
transactions.expected: agent B spends 10000 from tab B only

transactions.name: forbidden_payee_broadcast
transactions.expected: a payee outside the tab list is rejected. eth_call isValidSignature returned 0xffffffff

transactions.name: root_a_transfer_1
transactions.expected: PQ transfer of 1 raw unit from root A succeeds and consumes the nonce
transactions.actual: status 1. Root A balance before reclaim was 49999, which is 50000 minus this 1 unit

transactions.name: cross_root_replay
transactions.expected: the same PQ payload submitted to root B reverts InvalidSignature and does not consume B's nonce
transactions.actual: receipt status 0. eth_call revert data began with InvalidSignature selector 0x8baa579f. Root B nonce stayed aligned with the pre-replay nonce, and reclaim later succeeded

transactions.name: reclaim_a
transactions.expected: after expiry, reclaim returns the remaining tab balance once and openExposure falls by the original cap

transactions.name: reclaim_b
transactions.expected: root B reclaim is independent of root A

transactions.name: rotate_root_a
transactions.expected: pqVk becomes the new verifying key

transactions.name: old_key_rejected
transactions.expected: a transfer signed by the previous SLH-DSA key reverts InvalidSignature and does not consume the nonce
transactions.actual: eth_call revert 0x8baa579f, receipt status 0, following transfer with the new key succeeded at the same nonce

transactions.name: new_key_transfer
transactions.expected: the replacement SLH-DSA key can move 1 raw unit
